mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 200.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals robust demand growth, leading to elevated corporate revenue expectations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 1000.0 and RSAFS > 430000.0 in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed thresholds (t-test p > 0.05), or joint Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (as proxied by RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts signals a broad-based demand surge, leading to higher earnings expectations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 430000.0 and HOUST > 1000.0 in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS and HOUST exceed thresholds (t-test p > 0.05), or joint Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the core CPI inflation rate above 2.5% per annum signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts and increasing real interest rate expectations, which depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate below 5.5% and increase in payroll growth above 150k signals a tightening labor market, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5.5 and PAYEMS > 150.0 in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE < 5.5 and PAYEMS > 150.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or joint Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above 2.0% annualized growth signals strong economic momentum, increasing corporate earnings and investor confidence, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of GDPC1 > 2.0% (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
